Applications
The LinkPower™ PoE Network Solutions are designed to support a
wide range of critical applications across various industries,
delivering reliable power and connectivity where it matters most.
Smart Cities
The LinkPower™ solutions power essential smart city infrastructure, including
outdoor WiFi, traffic monitoring systems, and environmental sensors, enabling
cities to improve efficiency, safety, and connectivity
for their communities.
Smart Homes
By providing robust PoE connectivity, LinkPower solutions simplify the deployment
of smart home networks, supporting devices like security cameras, automation
hubs, and smart lighting systems for seamless integration.
IP Security
Ideal for IP surveillance systems, LinkPower products deliver reliable power and
data transmission for security cameras, access control systems, and monitoring
devices, ensuring continuous operation in critical environments.
Industrial Automation
Designed for harsh industrial settings, LinkPower solutions facilitate automated
machinery, sensors, and control systems, providing consistent performance even
in challenging outdoor or factory environments.
Education
LinkPower supports schools and campuses with outdoor WiFi solutions, IP
surveillance, and smart infrastructure to enhance learning, safety, and
communication across educational facilities.
Public Safety
For emergency response systems and public safety networks, LinkPower
products provide dependable connectivity and power to support surveillance,
communication systems, and smart sensors in mission-critical scenarios.

About LinkPower™ PoE Network
Solutions
Inscape Data, the leader in outdoor weatherproof PoE network
solutions, delivers the innovative LinkPower™ Network Solutions
portfolio. Designed to meet the rigorous demands of outdoor and
industrial networking applications, these solutions provide reliable
connectivity, robust power delivery, and seamless scalability for
diverse environments, including enterprise deployments and
municipal infrastructure projects.
Built with a focus on reliability and durability, LinkPower™ solutions
are engineered to perform in extreme conditions. Featuring
IP67/IP68-rated enclosures, advanced surge protection, and thermal
management, their All-in-One Box design ensures consistent
performance in harsh environments, making them the trusted choice
for critical applications where uptime and resilience are paramount.
